title: 第172章 太师，我要休了文茵！
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下半夜，李逸和武松四人谁都没有睡觉，他们一面在这间静室之内反复推敲着细节，一面等着蔡京从嘉王府回来。

终于，二更时分，蔡京的车驾回到了太师府。

此时的他，已经完全说服了嘉王赵楷。

面对天下至高权柄的诱惑，赵楷几乎没有任何犹豫便答应了下来。

“砰——”方依依直接开火，助理目不转睛的看着前方，额头处开始喷着血，看了一眼方依依，倒在了地上。

而李季行，好像没有注意到旁人异样打量的目光一般，依旧欣喜若狂的。

颜兮月坐在一边看着走了又来的行人，想了想，见一辆公交车是可以行驶在依市最好的风景区的，想到了电视上说的，不开心的时候，坐一下公交车，他会带你游玩整个城市。

之前沈清水问他九号之前能不能回去，刚好七号那天，高仁兮给宋庭君的意思是，他九号已经在南都了。

苏无双眉心撅起，看着顾玺包裹着的头，陷入昏迷，一时间她的内心也开始焦虑了。

下午，林茶正在上课，手机屏幕突然亮了起来，梁倾婵给她打了电话。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the second half of the night, neither Li Yi nor Wu Song slept. While they were deliberating over the details in this quiet room, they were waiting for Cai Jing to return from Prince Jia's Mansion.

Finally, at the second watch, Cai Jing's car returned to the Taishi Mansion.

At this time, he had completely convinced King Zhao Kai.

Facing the temptation of the supreme authority in the world, Zhao Kai agreed without any hesitation.

"Bang -" Fang Yiyi fired directly. The assistant looked forward intently, blood began to spurt from his forehead, glanced at Fang Yiyi, and fell to the ground.

But Li Jixing, as if he didn't notice the strange looking eyes of others, was still ecstatic.

Yan Xiyue sat aside and watched the pedestrians coming and going. She thought for a while and saw that a bus could drive in the best scenic spots in Yishi. She thought of what was said on TV: when you are unhappy, take a bus and it will take you around the whole city.

Shen Qingshui asked him before if he could go back before the 9th. On the 7th, Gao Renxi told Song Tingjun that he was already in Nandu on the 9th.

Su Wushuang raised her eyebrows and looked at Gu Xi's wrapped head, falling into coma. For a moment, she began to feel anxious.

In the afternoon, Lin Cha was in class when her phone screen suddenly lit up and Liang Qingchan called her.
